data.summary: The pod startup was slow due to a prolonged image pull, which took 28.724 seconds out of a total 30.0 seconds. The image, sized at 53.3 MB, was pulled at a low throughput of 1.86 MB/s. This rate is significantly below the expected threshold, indicating a bottleneck with the registry or network.

findings.statement: The total startup time was 30.0 seconds, exceeding the SLO threshold of 10.0 seconds.
The image pull phase was the dominant factor, lasting 28.724 seconds.
The image size was 53,328,919 bytes (approximately 53.3 MB).
The image pull throughput was 1,856,598 bytes/s (approximately 1.86 MB/s), which is below the expected threshold of 5 MB/s.

ruled_out.reason: The image size of 53.3 MB is not considered excessively large; the primary issue is the low pull throughput rather than the absolute size.
Application initialisation took only 1.689 seconds, which is a minor portion of the total startup time.
No time was spent on model loading, as indicated by a duration of 0.0 seconds for model-related spans.
The pod did not experience any scheduling delays, with the scheduling phase duration being 0.0 seconds and no failed scheduling events.
The readiness probe completed instantly (0.0 seconds duration) and there were no probe failures after the application was ready.
